body:
> When I talk about Refinement, I can only relate to RefinementList(dFR) and Menu(fR).

Yep, still, ultimately all connectors are doing refinements, in a way or another (numeric, faceting, sort). And I would rather not have the user to learn all the different APIS those connectors expose.

> Even if we keep the same name, there is a confusion in the way it accepts the props.

Yes and that will be the only thing you need to know, not the parameter or method naming.

> Also I would be pretty confused if hitsPerPage is renamed to default or current Refinement.

I hesitated on this one indeed. If you come from a previous Algolia experience with instantsearch.js it will be seen as weird. If you are new to Algolia and only learning the connectors API, this should be a consistent experience with all the other connectors.
